changelog: Implemented complete settings page, including automatic updates, start with windows, run in background when closed, etc.

historic_versions.changelog:
Implemented AppSettingsDTO with full versioning support.
Finalized persistent "My Crosshairs" section with saved state.
Changed renderer to support simple dot-only crosshair.
Added crosshair name and description fields.
Upgraded sharecode to V2 (now includes name + description).
Added import, export, save & reset functionality.
Added unbind hotkey button and improved hotkey handling.
Added color picker with "Click here" hint.
Improved Design page UI and added demo to Settings page.
Added active crosshair render on HomePage.
Fixed crosshair appearing in tabs and occasionally blocking the game.
Added static overlay support.
Centralized logic, prettified code, upgraded overall UI.
Removed old builds, SDC references, and obsolete code.
Fixed various UI bugs.

Major progress on new UI.
Added initial settings system and AppSettingsDTO foundation.
Improved hotkey handling and crosshair preview.
Began work on persistent crosshair features.

Started complete UI overhaul.
Introduced new modern interface structure.
Began migration to new settings architecture.
Added foundational changes for better crosshair rendering and customization.
Implemented a 'closest to 2px' policy to avoid going off center.
More crosshairs and included built version in the repository.
Made crosshair a 4-line version and improved preview functionality.
Semi-working crosshair implementation with color preview fixes in progress.
Added working example and multiple new crosshairs.
Added project files, initial setup, and basic crosshair structure.
Initial Release - Basic crosshair overlay for any game.
